figurative_meaning_en: words mixed with sweet and bitter tones
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাকে নরম-গরম কথা বলে বোঝানো হলো যে সে ভুল করেছে।
মায়ের নরম-গরম কথায় ছেলেটি শান্ত হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He was made to understand with a mix of soft and harsh words that he had made a mistake.
The boy calmed down with his mother's sweet and bitter words.
note: This idiom reflects the Bengali cultural tendency to balance affection with discipline in communication.
